sonnet.problem: The joke names "Mother Miller" without saying who she is. Bakers may not know Papa Dorin's backstory, so the line has to say it itself, for example "the woman who took me home from a closing bakery".
sonnet.rule: Bakers may not know anything about his story. Anything from his backstory, like the drawer, the Millers, the shiny new stamper or the angel, is said in the line itself
